data.one_liner: Base package containing common types and utilities for AWS Amplify Flutter packages.
data.what_it_does: Provides shared base types, utilities, and core components used across the AWS Amplify Flutter library. It serves as a foundation for Amplify features like Authentication, API, Analytics, and Storage.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application using AWS Amplify services.
avoid_when: You are not using AWS Amplify in your project.
You only need lightweight local data storage or basic networking without AWS.
strengths: Shared foundation for all AWS Amplify packages.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, MacOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Not a standalone utility; acts purely as a shared base dependency for Amplify plugins.
data.setup_notes: Added automatically as a dependency when installing other Amplify Flutter packages.
